assertions.name: hyp_C_decisively_resolved_for_natural_knots
assertions.source: Probe computes V(K) Taylor at q=1 for Hopf, trefoil 3_1, figure-eight 4_1, and cinquefoil T(2,5), reads off cubic coefficient, compares to required value. Reports CONFIRMED or REFUTED for each.

description: Concrete Hyp-C test for rung-2 lift. Computes Jones polynomial Taylor coefficient at (q-1)^3 for 4 natural knots (Hopf, trefoil 3_1, figure-eight 4_1, cinquefoil T(2,5)). Hyp-C is satisfied iff cubic Taylor coefficient = 1. Reports CONFIRMED or REFUTED per knot.

data.combined_status: All three rung-2 lift hypotheses now REFUTED in literal form: Hyp-A (Markov-trace-at-identity, PR #1801), Hyp-B (Wenzl p_3, this PR), Hyp-C (Jones-cubic over unknot, this probe). The categorical source of rung 2 = ℏ_q³/[2]_q remains OPEN; future work needs more exotic candidates (higher-genus knots, convention-shifted Kauffman brackets, or alternative quantum-group constructions).
